_source: af_core app/api/documents/[id]/create-entity/route.ts l.202-306 (SUPPLIER_INVOICE branch) and l.308-395 (EXPENSE_CLAIM, COMPANY_PURCHASE), commit a2fe220. 'ocrData' is the parsed Azure Document Intelligence result (prebuilt-invoice / prebuilt-receipt). Precedence: explicit user value → OCR field(s) in order → fallback. v3 uses this as the pre-fill of the 'create payable from document' form; every defaulted value is flagged for review.

sources: data.lineItems[] → {lineNumber: i+1, description || title, quantity ?? 1, unitPrice ?? amount, amount}
lines.fallback: one line {description: title, quantity 1, unitPrice: subtotal, amount: subtotal}
lines.v3: no lines unless a VAT split is wanted

supplier_invoice.document_link: DocumentLink entityType SUPPLIER_INVOICE, linkType ORIGINAL; document.processingStatus → ENTITY_CREATED
